ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১) Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 20 and 30 minutes respectively. If both the pipes are open in how many hours will the tank?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Part filled by (A and B) pipes in 1 min = (1​/20) + (1/30​)
                                                            = (3 + 2)/60
                                                            = 5/60
                                                            = 1/12

Time taken to fill the tank = (1 × 12)/1 minutes
                                          = 12 minutes

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২) A person has to cover a distance of 6 km in 45 minutes. If he covers one-half of the distance in two third of the total time, to cover the remaining distance in the remaining time, his speed (in km/hr.) must be
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Distance = 6 Km.
Time = 45 minutes.
He covers half of the distance (3 km) in 2/3 of the time

i.e. (2 × 45)/3 = 30 minutes = 1/2 hour.
Now, Time = 15 minutes = 15/60 = 1/4 hours.

Distance = 3 km.
Speed = 3/(1/4) = 12 Kmph.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩) A person crosses a 900 m long street in 5 minutes. What is his speed in km per hour?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed = 900/(5× 60) m/sec
            = 3 m/sec
            = (3 × 18)/5 km/hr.
            = 10.8 km/hr.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৪) A boy rides his bicycle 10 km at an average speed of 12 km/hr. and again travels 12km at an average speed of 10km/hr. His average speed of for the entire trip is approximately
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Total Distance = 10 + 12 = 22 km
Total time = (10/12) + (12/10)
                 = (5/6) + (6/5)
                 = (25 + 36)/30
                 = 61/30 hours
Average speed = 22/(61/30) = 660/61 = 10.8 km/hour

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৫) Two pipes A and B together can fill a tank in 6 hours. If pipe A can fill 5 hours faster than pipe B, in how many hours pipe B alone can fill the tank?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Pipe A and B can fill the tank = 6 hours 

Let
Pipe B can fill the tank in x hours
Pipe A will take x - 5 hours

Now
(1/x) + 1/(x - 5) = 1/6
(x - 5 + x)/x(x - 5) = 1/6
⇒ 6(x - 5 + x) = x2 - 5x
⇒ 12x - 30 = x2 - 5x
⇒ x2 - 17x + 30 = 0
⇒ x2 - 15x - 2x + 30 = 0
⇒ x(x - 15) - 2(x - 15) = 0
⇒ (x -15)(x - 2) = 0
x = 15 and x = 2

If x = 2, A = - 3 and time cannot be negative
So x = 15 hours
∴ B will fill the tank in 15 hours.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৬) A man can reach a certain place in 30 hours .If the reduces his speed by 1/15th, he goes 10 km less in that time. Find his speed.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let’s the speed of man = x km/hr.

According to the question
x × 30 - x × (14/15) × 30 = 10
⇒ 30x - 28x = 10
⇒ 2x = 10
⇒x = 10/2 
∴  x = 5

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৭) A man complete a journey in 10 hours. He travels first half of the journey at the rate of 16 km/hr and second half at the rate of 24 km/hr. Find the total journey in km.
৮) An outlet pipe can empty a cistern in 6 hours. In what time will it empty 2/3 part of the cistern?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
The outlet pipe empties the one complete cistern in 6 hours
Time taken to empty (2/3) × 6 = 4 hours

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৯) The ratio between the speeds of two trains is 8 : 9. If the second train runs 432 km in 4 hours, then the speed of the first train is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the speed of two trains be 8x and 9x km/hr.
It is given that the second train runs 432 km in 4 hours,

We have,
9x = 432/4
9x= 108
x = 108/9 
x = 12

The speed of the first train is = 8 × 12 = 96 km/hr.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১০) A tap can fill a tank in 12 hrs. After half the tank is filled, three more similar taps are opened. What is the total time taken to fill the tank completely?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
A tap can fill the tank in 12 hours
 One hour work of one tap = 1/12
⇒ One hour work of 4 taps = 4/12 = 1/3

4 taps 1/3 part can fill the tank in 1 hour 
4 taps 1 part can fill the tank in 1× 3 hours 
4 taps 1/2 part can fill the tank in (1× 3)/2 hours 
                                                     = 3/2 = 1.5 hours

⇒ Total time to fill the tank = 6 hours to first half + 1.5 hour to second half
∴ The required result will be 7.5 hours.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১১) With an average speed of 50 km/hr a train reaches its destination in time. If it goes with an average speed of 40 km/hr, it is late by 24 minutes. The total journey is -
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the distance to be covered be x km
⇒ (x/40) - (x/50) = 24/60
⇒ (5x - 4x)/200 = 2/5
⇒ x/200 = 2/5
⇒ x = (2/5) × 200
⇒ x = 80 km.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১২) Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 18hrs and 6hrs respectively. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously, how much time will be taken to fill the tank?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Part filled by A in 1 hour =1​/18

Part filled by B in 1 hour =1/6

Part filled by (A + B) in 1 hour =(1/18) + (1/6)
                                                = (1 + 3)/18
                                                = 4/18
                                                = 2/9

Hence, both the pipes together will fill the tank in 9/2 hours

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৩) In covering a certain distance, The speeds of A and B are in the ratio of 5 : 6. A takes 30 minutes more than B to reach the destination. The time taken by A to reach the destination is-
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Ratio of speeds =5 : 6 
⇒ Ratio of times taken =6 : 5
Let A and B take 6x and 5x hrs. to reach the destination. 
Then
6x - 5x=30​/60
x =1/2​

∴ Time taken by A =(6 × 1​)/2 hours
                               = 3 hours

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৪) The average speed of a bus is one-third of the speed of a train. The train covers 1200 km in 16 hours. How much distance will the bus cover in 48 minutes?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed of the train = (1200/16) km/hr.
                              = 75 km/hr.


Speed of the bus = (1/3)×75 km/hr.
                             = 25 km/hr.


Distance covered by the bus in 60 min = 25 km

Distance covered by the bus in 48 min =(25/60) × 48 km
                                                               =20 km

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৫) One pipe can fill a tank three times as fast as another pipe. If together the two pipes can fill the tank in 18 minutes, then the slower pipe alone will be able to fill the tank in:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let
the slower pipe alone fill the tank in x minutes.
Then, faster pipe will fill it in x/3 minutes

Now
1/x + 3/x = 1/18
(3 + 1)/x = 1/18
4/x = 1/18
x = 72 minutes

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৬) A person travels equal distances with speeds of 4 km/hr , 5 km/hr and 6 km/hr and takes a total time of 37 minutes. The total distance (in km) is-
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the total distance be 3x km
Now 
(x/4) + (x/5) + (x/6) = 37/60
(15x + 12x + 10x)/60 = 37/60
37x/60 = 37/60
37x = 37
x = 1 
The total distance be 3x km
                                = 3 × 1 = 3 km

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৭) A train travels a distance of 600 km at a constant speed. If the speed of the train is increased by 5 km/hr, the journey would take 4 h less. Find the speed of the train?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let the speed of the train be x km/hr.

Now
(600/x) - 600/(x + 5) = 4
{600(x + 5) - 600x}/x(x + 5) = 4
3000/x(x + 5) = 4
4x2 + 20x - 3000 = 0
4(x2 + 5x - 750) = 0
x2 + 5x - 750 = 0
x2 + 30x - 25x - 750 = 0
x(x + 30) - 25(x + 30) = 0
(x + 30)(x - 25) = 0 
∴ x = 25 

The initial speed of the train is 25 km/hr.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৮) A man takes 50 minutes to cover a certain distance at a speed of 6 km/hr. If he walks with a speed of 15 km/hr, he covers the same distance in :
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Distance=Speed × Time
Distance=(6×50)/60 km
Distance=5 km

∴ Required time=Distance/ Speed
=5/15 hrs.
=1/3 hrs
= 20 min

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ১৯) A covers a certain distance in 3 hours with a constant speed of 60 km/h. What should be the speed of B to cover the same distance in 2 hours 30 minutes?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
A's time = 3 hours
A's speed = 60 km/h

B's time = 2 hours 30 minutes

Speed = Distance/time

D = 60 × 3 = 180 km

B's speed = 180/2.5
⇒ B's speed = 72 km/h
∴ B's speed is 72 km/h

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২০) A tank is filled in 8 hours by three pipes A, B and C. The pipe C is twice as fast as B and B is twice as fast as A. How much time will pipe A alone take to fill the tank?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let
Pipe A can fill the tank in x hours. Then,
Pipe B can fill the tank in x/2 hours,
Pipe C can fill the tank in x/4 hours.

Part filled by pipe A in 1 hour = 1/x
Part filled by pipe B in 1 hour = 2/x
Part filled by pipe C in 1 hour = 4/x

Now 
1/x + 2/x + 4/x = 1/8
(1 + 2 + 4)/x = 1/8
7/x = 1/8 
x = 56 hours

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২১) A runs twice as fast as B and B runs thrice as fast as C. The distance covered by C in 78 minutes, will be covered by A in :
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
The ratio of the speed of A, B and C = 6 ∶ 3 ∶ 1
The ratio of the time taken = 1/6 ∶ 1/3 ∶ 1 = 1 ∶ 2 ∶ 6

Time taken by C to cover the distance = 78 minutes

If C takes 6 min, then A takes 1 min.
If C takes 78 min, then A takes 78 × (1/6) min.
                                                = 13 minutes.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২২) Two pipes A and B can fill a cistern in 12 minutes and 15 minutes respectively while a third pipes C can empty the full cistern in 6 minutes. A and B are kept open for 5 minutes in the beginning and then C is also opened. In what time is the cistern emptied?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Part filled in 5 min = 5 × {(1/15) + (1/12)}
                              = 5 × {(4 + 5)/60}
                              = 5× (9/60)
                              = 3/4

Part emptied in 1 minute when all the pipes are opened = (1/6) - {(1/15) + (1/12)}
                                                                                          = (10 - 4 - 5)/60
                                                                                          = 1/60
Now,
1​/60 part is emptied in 1 minute.
3/4 part is emptied in =60 ×(3/4) = 45minutes

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৩) A cyclist rides 24 km at 16 kmph and further 36 km at 20 kmph. Find his average speed for the journey.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Total distance travelled :
= (24 + 36) km
= 60 km


Total time taken :
(24/16) + (36/20) hours 
= (3/2) + (9/5) hours
= (15 + 18)/10 hours
= 33/10 hours

∴ Average speed : 60 × (10/33) km/hr.
                            = 600/33 km/hr.
                              = 18.18 km/hr.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৪) If Nazir travels at a speed of 70 kmph and covers a distance in 9 hours. Then how much time will he takes to travel the same distance at a speed of 90 kmph?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Speed of Nazir = 70 kmph
Time = 9 hours
distance = 70 × 9 = 630 Km 

Time taken to cover 630 km at 90 km/hr 

Required time = 630/90 = 7 hours

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৫) A pump can fill a tank with water in 4 hours. Because of a leak, it took 9/2 hours to fill the tank. The leak can drain all the water of the tank in:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Part of the tank filled by the pump in 1 hour = 1/4
Part of the tank filled by the pump in 1 hour because of the leak = 2/9
∴ Part of the tank emptied by the leak in 1 hour = 1/4 - 2/9
                                                                             = (9 - 8)/36
                                                                             = 1/36
∴ Leak will empty the tank in 36 hours

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৬) A fuel tank is 1/5th full and requires 32 gallons more to make it 3/7 full. What is the capacity of the tank?
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
দেওয়া আছে,
একটি ট্যাংকে 1/5 অংশ পূর্ণ আছে।
ট্যাংকটির  3/7 অংশ পূর্ণ করতে আরো 32 গ্যালন জ্বালানী লাগবে।
মনে করি, ট্যাংকটির ধারণ ক্ষমতা = x গ্যালন

প্রশ্নমতে,
    3x/7 - x/5 = 32 
বা, (15x - 7x)/35 = 32
বা, 8x/35 = 32বা, x = (35 × 32)/8
বা, x = 140

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৭) Mamun is faster than Jahid. Mamun and Jahid each walk 24 km. The sum of their speeds is 7 km/hr and the sum of time taken by them is 14 hours. Then Mamun's speed is equal to:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let Mamun's speed = x km/hr
Then, Jahid's speed = (7 - x) km/hr
So,
(24/x) + {24/(7 - x)} = 14 
⇒24(7 - x) + 24x =14x(7 - x)
⇒ 168 - 24x + 24x = 98x - 14x2
⇒ 14x2  - 98x + 168 = 0 
⇒ 14(x2 - 7x + 12) = 0
x2 - 7x + 12 = 0
x2 - 3x - 4x + 12 = 0
x(x - 3) - 4(x - 3) = 0
(x - 3)(x - 4) = 0
x = 3, 4 
Mamun is faster than Jahid
Mamun's speed = 4 km/hr.
Jahid's speed = 3 km/hr.

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৮) A farmer travelled a distance of 61 km in 9 hours. He travelled partly on foot at 4 km/hr. and partly on bicycle at 9 km/hr. The distance travelled on foot is:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Let
the distance travelled on foot be x km.
Then, distance travelled on bicycle = (61 -x) km.
(x/4) + {(61 -x)/9} = 9
9x + 4(61 - x) = 9 × 36 
9x + 244 - 4x = 324 
5x + 244 = 324 
5x = 324 - 244 
5x = 80
x = 16

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ২৯) 12 buckets of water fill a tank when the capacity of each bucket is 13.5 litres. How many buckets will be needed to fill the same tank, if the capacity of each bucket is 3 liters.
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
ট্যাংকের ধারণ ক্ষমতা = 12 × 13.5 = 162
দেয়া আছে, প্রতিটি বাকেটের ধারণ ক্ষমতা = 3 লিটার
মোট বাকেট লাগবে = 162/3 = 54 টি

ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.question: ৩০) Pipes A and B can fill a tank in 8 and 6 hours respectively. Pipe C can empty it in 12 hours. If all the three pipes are opened together, then the tank will be filled in:
ব্যাংক নিয়োগ প্রস্তুতি.exp:
Pipes A can fill a tank in 8 hours
Pipes A can fill 1/8 portion of a tank in 1 hour

Pipes B can fill a tank in 6 hours
Pipes B can4 fill 1/6 portion of a tank in 1 hour

Pipe C can empty it in 12 hours.
Pipe C can empty 1/12 portion of it in 1 hour.

Pipes A, B and C together can fill (1/8 + 1/6 - 1/12) = (3 + 4 - 2)/24
                                                or 5/24portion of a tank in 1 hour


∴The tank will be full in 24/5 hours
